Marta (docs): quickfire thread: i'm putting together a tiny migration note for Optimize toolkit. goal = one-page cheat: 3 clipboard-ready snippets (batching json, kv-prefetch minimal SDK, quant tip), a 3-step checklist, and 2 links. keep it super short. any red flags?
Hector (eng): sounds perfect. pls include a streaming auth tip beige customers forget `Accept: text/event-stream`. also make batching json copy/paste-ready for Dedicated.
Pri (opt): add one simple sentence on when to choose `dynamic_batch=auto` vs manual caps. 1-2 lines.
Sam (pm): product line to add: "Expected wins: lower p95 and reduced token cost. Caveat: monitor short-sequence latency."
Marta (docs): ok drafting now. Hector, can you paste a 3-line kv-prefetch snippet i can drop in?
Hector (eng): use this minimal SDK example:```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = cli.generate("summarize: keep it to one line", prefetch_kv=True)
```
Marta (docs): nice. Pri, your 1-liner quant guidance?
Pri (opt): "Prefer int8 for high-throughput batched workloads when small quality delta is acceptable; prefer fp16/bf16 for latency-sensitive short inputs. Always run a 50-sample smoke eval against representative prompts before rollout."
Marta (docs): added. batching JSON (copy/paste):```json
{
  "batching_policy": {
    "max_batch_tokens": 4096,
    "min_requests": 2,
    "timeout_ms": 20
  }
}
```
Hector (eng): nice. add a short note: if p95 rises, try lowering timeout_ms to 10 and reduce max_batch_tokens.
Marta (docs): added note. checklist at top: 1) run 20-50 sample smoke eval, 2) enable kv-prefetch for routes with high prefix reuse, 3) tune batching caps or set to auto.
Sam (pm): include a rollback blurb: "Console > Deployments > Routes > select previous model variant > promote." one line.
linkbot: PR #10021 opened by Marta — "optkit-quickfire-migration" (1 file). CI: docs-lint passed; linkcheck failed: 1 broken link.
Marta (docs): ack. likely the old kv-prefetch path. Hector, canonical URL for kv-prefetch?
Hector (eng): set it to https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/kv-prefetch. telemetry canonical is https://docs.redwood.ai/console/telemetry-guide.
Marta (docs): updated both links in PR. added the SSE header example for streaming:```http
GET /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY
Accept: text/event-stream
```
Pri (opt): tiny add: when to pick manual cap: "use manual caps when p95 is sensitive and traffic bursts cause increased variance."
Marta (docs): added. re-run linkcheck.
linkbot: linkcheck re-run — passing. PR #10021 merged. :tada:
Sam (pm): awesome. can we follow up with a short screenshot for the rollback UI? create a follow-up ticket.
Marta (docs): will do. final checklist: @Hector confirm snippets/urls, @Pri confirm quant sentence.
